description:
Activate Oketra by paying {3}{W}, creating a 1/1 Frog, a 1/1 Warrior and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Warrior, Squirrel or Frog, untapping a basic Plains.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
